title: Semspec profile
description: A profile tells the explorer what the fields of a graph mean: the node kinds, how nodes nest, which fields name other nodes, the lifecycle, the title rules, the chips and the details.

project.description: The name of the project. The page shows it as secondary text.

nodes.description: The key of the list of nodes in the graph.

id.description: The key of the id of a node.

kind.description: The key of the kind of a node.

defaultKind.description: The kind of a node that has no value in the kind key. It must be a kind of the profile.

body.description: The field that gets the text after the front matter of a Markdown page. A graph folder reads *.md files only when this key is set.

markdown.description: Turns on the reading of Markdown pages in a graph folder. The front matter of a page holds the fields of a node.

title.description: Fields that hold a title. The first non-empty one wins. A node with none gets a title from its id.

idPrefixPattern.description: A regular expression. The part of the id that it matches is cut before the id becomes a title.

statement.description: Fields that hold the main text of a node. The first non-empty one wins.

level.description: The field of the level of a node, for example a priority.

delivery.description: The field of the delivery state of a node, for example a release.

fallback.description: The state of a node that has none.

states.description: A state with `muted` set shows struck through and dimmed. The node counts as not live.

edges.description: 1 entry for each edge name: the parent and link fields, and the names of the part edge and of the check edge.

labels.description: The label from the source and the label from the target.

down.description: Set when the target is the more general node. The layout puts it on the left.

target.description: For a link field: the key of the node id in an object of the field. The default is "id". The other keys of the object are the properties of the edge.

from.description: The kinds that the source node of an edge of this name may have.

to.description: The kinds that the target node of an edge of this name may have.

iri.description: A full IRI or a CURIE with a prefix that iri.prefixes declares. It maps the term to an existing class or property. Without it, the export mints an IRI.

properties.description: The properties of an edge of this name, by property name.

type.description: A date is an ISO date string: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD.

required.description: Set when every edge of this name must have the property.

vocabulary.description: The id of a vocabulary. The value of the property must be a code of the vocabulary. The type must be string.

iri.description: A full IRI or a CURIE with a prefix that iri.prefixes declares. It maps the term to an existing class or property. Without it, the export mints an IRI.

links.description: Fields that hold lists of node ids and are not parent fields.

crossLinks.description: Fields that point into another graph of the workspace. Each field holds 1 node id or a list of node ids of the target graph. A field can also be an embedded field. These links are not edges of this graph.

field.description: The field of a node. It holds 1 node id or a list of node ids of the target graph.

graph.description: The id of the target graph in the workspace file.

label.description: The title of the section in the details panel, for example "Uses term".

refs.description: A field that holds a list of objects, each with the id of a node and a note. Give 1 entry or a list of entries. Each field needs an entry in edges, which gives the labels of the edge.

supersededBy.description: The field that names the node that replaces this node.

linkedScopeEdges.description: The edges that pull a linked node into the scope of a node.

kind.description: The kind that each part becomes.

owner.description: The kind of the node that owns the parts.

field.description: The field of the owner that holds the list of parts.

id.description: The field of a part that holds its name.

text.description: The field of a part that holds its text.

edge.description: The name of the edge from a part to its owner.

owner.description: The kind of the node that holds the object.

field.description: A dotted path to the object in the owner.

kind.description: The kind that each distinct object becomes.

id.description: The key of the id inside the object. An object needs it. A string or a number in the field is the id itself.

edge.description: The name of the edge from the owner to the new node. The edge is a parent field of the owner.

kind.description: The kind that each check becomes.

field.description: The field that holds a list of checks, on a node or on a part.

typeField.description: The field of a check that holds its type.

key.description: Fields that make the identity of a check. 2 checks with the same type and key share 1 node.

title.description: Fields for the title. The first non-empty one wins.

status.description: A status that a node carries in 1 field. A node with no status of its own gets the roll-up of the nodes below it.

values.description: Exactly 1 value of each tone, in the order good, warn, bad.

detail.description: A list field that the details panel shows next to the status of a node.

vocabularies.description: Vocabularies by scheme id. A vocabulary maps to a skos:ConceptScheme and lists the codes that a field can take, with their meaning. An entry is the vocabulary itself, or an object with a `file` key. The file holds the vocabulary in JSON or YAML, and its path is relative to the profile.

file.description: The path of the vocabulary file, relative to the profile.

iri.description: The IRIs of the export. See the Export section of the README.

base.description: The start of the IRI of a node and of a minted term. A node IRI is <base><kind>/<id>. A minted term is <base>vocab/<name>.

prefixes.description: Namespace IRIs by prefix, for the CURIEs of the profile.

field.description: The node field that holds the IRI of the node. A node without the field gets a minted IRI.

fieldIris.description: The property of a node field, by field name. A full IRI or a CURIE.

fieldVocabularies.description: The vocabulary of a field, by field path. The field is a node field, the lifecycle field or the field of a field filter. A value that is not a code of the vocabulary is an error.

search.description: The words that the search reads. Every part is optional.

synonymFields.description: Node fields with words that mean the same as the title, for example a list of words to avoid. A query that matches the title also searches these words, and the other way round.

fields.description: More node fields to index. A field path can have dots.

boost.description: The weight of a field in the ranking, by field name. The built-in names are id, title, sub, statement and parts. The defaults are 2, 3, 1, 1 and 1.

embeddings.description: The optional model for meaning search. The user names the provider and the model and accepts the licence of the model. Semspec ships no model and has no default model. A workspace file can set it too, and then it wins.

provider.description: ollama: a local Ollama server. openai-compatible: a server with POST /v1/embeddings. command: a program that reads JSON on stdin and writes JSON on stdout.

model.description: The name of the model. The provider passes it on.

endpoint.description: The base URL of the server. The default for ollama is http://127.0.0.1:11434. It is required for openai-compatible.

dimensions.description: The size of the stored vectors. A longer vector is cut to this size and scaled to length 1.

batch.description: The most texts in 1 request. The default is 32.

apiKeyEnv.description: The name of the environment variable that holds the API key. Only for openai-compatible. The key never sits in a file.

command.description: The program and its arguments, for the provider command. No shell reads them.

documentPrefix.description: A text that goes before each node text. Some models need it.

queryPrefix.description: A text that goes before the query. Some models need it.

index.description: The path of the index file. The default is the graph path with .semspec-index.json added.

gates.description: The gaps that fail the check command. Every part is optional. A gap that is not listed never fails the check.

fail.description: The gap kinds that fail the check. bad-status: a node whose own status has the tone bad. no-check: a part with no check. no-source: a node that needs a source and has none. unplaced: a node that no parent field places. unresolved-link: a link to a node that is not in the graph. broken-cross-link: a cross link to a node that is not in the other graph. missing-deliverable: a node that misses a deliverable of its kind.

deliverables.description: What a task on a node of a kind must deliver, by kind id. The check command, the gaps tool and the slice report what a node misses.

parts.description: The node has at least min parts.

checks.description: each-part: each part of the node has a check. node: the node has a check.

status.description: The status of the node is one of these status values or tones.

fields.description: These node fields have a value.

links.description: For each edge or cross link field, the node has at least min links.

direction.description: out (the default): the links of the node. in: the links that name the node.

provenance.description: The node has the marker and the source that the profile provenance names.
Where a fact comes from, in the shape of W3C PROV-O. The fields apply to a node, to an edge property and to a refs item. Every part is optional.

label.description: The label of the filter by marker. The default is Provenance.

marker.description: How the fact was obtained. The value is a code of the vocabulary. It maps to the type of the prov:Activity that generated the fact.

vocabulary.description: The id of the vocabulary that holds the codes.

source.description: Where the fact was read. It maps to prov:wasDerivedFrom.

kind.description: The kind of a source node. When set, the field holds the id of a node of this kind, and the explorer makes an edge from the node to the source node.

edge.description: The name of the edge to the source node. The default is derivedFrom.

retrieved.description: The field of the date when the fact was read: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD, not in the future. It maps to prov:generatedAtTime.

agent.description: The field of the person or system that is responsible for the fact. It maps to prov:wasAttributedTo.

note.description: The field of a free note on the origin.

requireSource.description: Marker codes. A node or an edge with one of these markers must have a source. Needs marker and source.

fieldFilters.description: Filters on a list field or a text field of a node. A node of a kind with no such field takes the values of the nodes above or below it.

groupBy.description: The picker groups the values by the text before the first separator.

from.description: With `keys`, the values are the keys of the objects in the list field. Without it, the values are the items of the field.

entry.description: The start page lists the nodes of this kind, with the number of their children.

layout.description: The layout of the Graph and Cards views.

default.description: The layout that the views start with. The default is layered. The value grouped needs groupEdge.

groupEdge.description: The name of an edge. The target of the edge is the container of its source. The grouped layout draws the source inside the target.

layout.description: The layout of the Graph and Cards views.

default.description: The layout that the views start with. The default is layered. The value grouped needs groupEdge.

groupEdge.description: The name of an edge. The target of the edge is the container of its source. The grouped layout draws the source inside the target.

details.description: What the details panel shows. See the README.

field.description: A dotted path in the node.

statementTitle.description: The title of the statement section for each kind. The key `default` holds the fallback.

textSections.description: A section with the text of a field, optionally for some kinds only.

optionSections.description: A list of objects with a main text and a second text.

sourceSections.description: A list of objects with a name and optional section, URL and retrieval date. Each value is a key of the object.

value.description: Keys of the object. The first non-empty one is the text.

objectLists.description: A list of objects, 1 line each, with a badge.

labels.description: A label for "<tag>.<key>" and for "<tag>". A missing label falls back to the tag and the key as written.

taggedLists.description: A list of objects with exactly 1 key, the tag. 1 line for each inner key of a tag.

citations.description: A citation section for a linked kind.

vocabulary.description: A vocabulary maps to a skos:ConceptScheme.

label.description: The name of the scheme. It maps to skos:prefLabel.

definition.description: What the scheme covers. It maps to skos:definition.

iri.description: The IRI of the scheme. Optional.

items.description: A concept maps to a skos:Concept.

code.description: The value that a field holds. It maps to skos:notation.

label.description: The text that the explorer shows for the code. It maps to skos:prefLabel.

definition.description: What the code means. It maps to skos:definition.

broader.description: The code of the broader concept of the scheme. It maps to skos:broader.

altLabels.description: Other names of the concept. They map to skos:altLabel. They are not valid values.

order.description: Sorts the concepts in a list. A concept with no order comes last.

iri.description: The IRI of the concept. Optional.

field.description: The field of a node that holds the list of objects.

target.description: The key of the node id in an object.

note.description: The key of the edge note in an object.

many.description: The key of a boolean in an object. When it is true, the edge note gets the suffix [], for example lines[].

parents.description: Groups of parent fields. The first group that names a node places the node in the tree. Every group makes the scope.

iri.description: A full IRI or a CURIE with a prefix that iri.prefixes declares. It maps the term to an existing class or property. Without it, the export mints an IRI.

placedUnder.description: A node of this kind is placed when it reaches a node of the named kind.

source.description: A path to the field that names the source.

name.description: A path to the display name of the source. A value at the path is the name as written. An empty value falls back to the name made from the source.
